name: Default
shortDescription: Platform for building LLM apps, agentic workflows and RAG pipelines, with PostgreSQL, Redis, Weaviate, a plugin daemon and code sandboxes.

alerts.message: Open /install right after the first deploy: whoever completes it first creates the admin account. Model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama and others) need their own API keys or endpoints, added as plugins in Settings.
